tags.name: Lighthouse Reef
tags.description: Sheltered muck and macro diving site in a bay on the northeast side of Sangeang Island, known locally as Tanjung Menjangan. Black volcanic sand slopes mixed with colorful coral garden, reaching about 29m. Premier critter diving with frogfish, nudibranchs, boxer crabs, pipefishes, pygmy seahorses, and flame file shells with their signature electric-flash light displays. Calmer conditions than other Sangeang sites make it suitable for less experienced divers.
